title: add RAG agent templates, tool-calling examples, and docs quickstarts
author: Evelyn Park
description: Context: This PR adds a first-class set of RAG agent templates and tool-calling example quickstarts for Python and TypeScript SDKs, and wires the examples into the docs site quickstarts section. Motivation: make it trivial for customers to get started with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) agents and tool-calling patterns using Redwood runtime features (streaming, function calling, and cached retriever integrations). What this changes: - Adds agent templates (config + example prompts) for FAQ bot, contract assistant, and data-extraction agent. - Adds example implementations for Python and TypeScript showing: retriever setup, agent loop, tool registration, and structured output parsing. - Adds docs/quickstarts pages, sidebars, and example links to the docs site; includes copy and screenshots. - Small runtime compat shim to expose tool metadata to the SDK examples (non-breaking). Checklist: - [x] Agent templates added under examples/agents/templates - [x] Python quickstart added examples/rag-agent/python/quickstart.py - [x] TypeScript quickstart added examples/rag-agent/ts/quickstart.ts - [x] Docs pages added docs/quickstarts/rag-agent-quickstart.md and sidebar updated - [x] Unit tests for examples runner - [x] Integration smoke test with example retriever (flaky on first run; re-ran CI) Testing notes: local unit tests and example smoke tests executed; CI initially flagged one flaky retriever integration test (timeout on Windows runners) which was retried and passed. No runtime behavior changes for existing customers; the SDK shim is opt-in and behind a feature flag. Related: ENG-4821 (RAG quickstart push), ENG-4789 (tools metadata export).
commits: feat(agents): add FAQ / contract / data-extraction agent templates
feat(examples): add python and ts quickstarts with retriever + tool-calling
docs: add rag-agent quickstart page and sidebar entry
test: add unit tests and example smoke test harness
chore: bump docs site quickstart index and example links
review_comments: Liam Chen: Nice set of templates, suggest renaming contract-assistant prompt variable to 'contract_text' for clarity. -> Evelyn Park: Renamed variable and added comment describing expected schema.

Maya Patel: Docs copy looks good; can we include a short TL;DR for expected costs and latency tradeoffs? -> Evelyn Park: Added a short 'Performance and cost' section with recommendations (batching, caching, quantization) and links to Optimize guide.

Noah Williams: The SDK shim touches infra; is there a migration risk? Recommend feature flag default off. -> Evelyn Park: Feature flag added (RAG_AGENT_TOOL_META=false by default) and documented in infra_shims/README.
CI bot: integration/test_retriever timed out on windows-latest (flaky). -> Evelyn Park: Increased timeout and added retry harness; re-ran CI and tests passed.
release_notes: Added RAG agent templates and quickstarts (Python + TypeScript) plus docs site quickstart pages; new examples demonstrate retriever integration, tool calling, and structured output parsing. Includes opt-in SDK shim to expose tool metadata for richer tool-calling UX.
